_comment: Live logprob-study endpoints on 8x B300. Populated as models come up. All expose OpenAI-compatible /v1/completions + /v1/chat/completions with logprobs=True/top_logprobs and prompt_logprobs (echo=True). vLLM 0.25.1, torch 2.11+cu130, sm_103a. KV cache bf16 (NEVER fp8). --max-logprobs 25.

fp8_fidelity.verdict: fp8 SAFE for logprob deltas; noise ~0.03 nats << expected debate-round shift; DeepSeek native fp8 OK

llama70b.note: ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (config verified identical). Study reference (clean bf16).
llama70b.verified: 2026-07-21T00:07Z chat-logprobs OK (agree/disagree/partially all measurable); TP=2 NCCL on B300 OK
llama70b.surface_note: NOT a reasoning model. Rendered ctx ends mid-line ('My rating (A-G):') → model emits a SPACE-prefixed letter ' A' (id 362), UNLIKE Qwen/DeepSeek (bare). ' A'.. ' G' target reads 1.0 mass. MOST RLHF-saturated of the roster: letter margin ~10.75 nats, p(argmax)~0.99998 — argmax-flip DV dead, needs T~8 for continuous range.

qwen3_235b.verified: 2026-07-21T00:45Z chat-logprobs OK; TP=2 NCCL on B300 OK
qwen3_235b.reasoning_note: HYBRID REASONING MODEL: emits <think> as the FIRST token unless disabled. For the max_tokens=1 stance/letter read you MUST pass chat_template_kwargs={"enable_thinking": false}, else the next-token read scores <think> not a letter. With thinking off, letters A-G appear normally. Far LESS RLHF-saturated than Llama-70B (letter margin ~1.6 nats, p(argmax)~0.72 vs Llama 10.75 nats/0.99998).

deepseek_v3.note: fp8 is the reference format. TP=4 (128 heads; TP=2 impossible at 335GB/GPU).
deepseek_v3.verified: 2026-07-21T00:55Z chat-logprobs OK; TP=4 NCCL+DeepGEMM MoE JIT on B300 OK
deepseek_v3.surface_note: NOT a reasoning model (no <think> in chat_template). Rendered ctx ends '...(A-G):<|Assistant|>' → model emits a BARE letter 'C' (no leading space), like Qwen-think-off, UNLIKE Llama (space-prefixed ' A'). LEAST RLHF-saturated of the roster: letter margin ~0.0-0.77 nats, p(argmax)~0.46 (near-uniform over C/D). The discrete/argmax read is fully alive here.
